objective: Test whether the enlarged marked first-frame state gate improves actual entry timing on new source groups
selection: One fixed cohort of 12 ego-Yes CCD clips, unique source groups; exclude all prior 12 CCD groups and public CCD groups before SHA256 full-ID ordering. No replacement or expanded cohort after review/results.
baseline: Unmodified frozen V6c Mac native/sync/deepstack path, four actual VLM calls per clip; use baseline_prediction from reused paired worker and ignore its unrelated contact ablation output.
treatment: Share identical baseline outputs and calls. For every counterpart mark approved before prediction, ask the unchanged first-frame state prompt on a 1152x768 nearest-neighbor 3x enlargement of the same384x256 marked first tile. Strict valid INSIDE changes entry_frame to first original frame. OUTSIDE, UNCERTAIN, invalid JSON, or absent/unapproved mark preserve baseline. Other three fields remain exact.
state_input_choice: Upsampled arm fixed without new resolution/prompt search; same previous state worker, 40-token cap, same first-frame prompt, yellow upper-body 2px outline at384x256 then3x. No original source detail reintroduction.
privileged_information: Human-like expert-agent counterpart marking is privileged, not an automatic deployable target detector. Reference labels or source time metadata are not passed to workers; original burned-in content is retained.
review: Two independent AI visual reviews on all12 full sequences and native details, blinded to provider accident labels/new model outputs/peer. Then documented peer adjudication before model execution; original independent reviews unchanged. Unknown labels remain unknown. Same counterpart, first-wheel boundary evidence and pre-start encoding checked.
reference_contract: Use conservative union of compatible A/B entry intervals; disagreement or unsupported timing stays unknown. Before-start entry encodes first-frame 0 but physical entry time is unknown before video. State labels are secondary and separate from timing. Markability does not depend on timing eligibility.
coverage: Baseline all12. State queries only for preapproved visible same-counterpart markers, including timing-unknown cases. No marker means baseline fallback; include these cases when entry reference is eligible. Missing timing references are not scored as wrong or correct.
evaluation: Native PTS and original frame numbers, inclusive0.3second tolerance. Interval definite correct/wrong/indeterminate plus shared-true-time paired accuracy and MAE delta bounds; no midpoint labels. Report start-before/during strata, marker coverage, all state responses, new false-first choices and unchanged other3 outputs.
runtime: Mac only, offline model workers. At most60 actual VLM calls:48baseline plus at most12state. Baseline is shared for paired policy scoring, not separately re-inferred for treatment. Independent CPU replay/strict result validation after workers finish.
stop: Complete frozen cohort and this single gate policy; no label revision or extra prompt/resolution variants based on model results. No production change or official S2 claim. Insufficient reference strata means inconclusive, not automatic cohort extension.
pre_prediction_amendment: Expert preflight: additionally count/gate newly forced first frames on known OUTSIDE state across all queried cases, even if timing is unknown. State-based error is reported separately from timing accuracy.
